caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden duck mounted on a simple rectangular wooden base with a vertical support stick. The duck is positioned in profile, facing to the left, and has a muted color palette that consists mainly of earthy browns and grays, with slight reddish-brown hues on the head and a touch of dark markings on the back and base of the neck. The texture and grain of the wood are visible, giving the duck a rustic, hand-carved appearance. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or scenery. There is a small area of handwritten text in the lower right corner of the paper.
title: Gadwall Decoy
